{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit sweater, slim fit with a softly scooped neckline and three-quarter sleeves, in dusty steel blue #6f8397, merino-silk blend

Midi skirt, A-line with a defined waist, falling just below the knee, in deep burgundy #5a2a3a, wool crepe

Sheer tights, in smoky black #2b2a2e, 20 denier matte knit

Ankle boots, almond toe with a stable block heel, in black #1f1c1f, smooth leather

Coat, single-breasted, tailored, knee-length, in charcoal #3a3d44, wool-cashmere blend

Small structured top-handle bag, in black #1f1c1f, grained leather

Drop earrings, small and slim, in silver tone #c0c0c8, polished metal

Why this outfit works: the neat knit-and-skirt pairing is polished enough for an evening at the theatre without feeling stiff, and the heeled boots keep it comfortable through the performance and the walk home. The dusty steel blue echoes her eye color and sits softly against her fair, rosy skin, while the burgundy adds depth and warmth that read richly under artificial light. The A-line skirt defines the waist and moves gracefully, and the dark tights, boots and bag keep the palette cohesive. The tailored wool coat covers the chill of an autumn evening and can be left in the cloakroom, so the outfit still looks complete without it."}
